# Templates in the app

The person does these in the Whatsable app. Give the path and the steps; never say you did it. Fetch the "Full steps" address for the exact steps, or give the person the link.

## Change a submitted template (duplicate it)

- **What it is:** A submitted template cannot be edited: duplicate it to a draft, change it and submit the copy.
- **Plan:** Bulk Message, Work, Growth, Pro, Agency, the 14-day trial and the Free plan.
- **Who can do it:** Owners, admins and members.
- **Where:** Templates > the template's menu > Duplicate to draft
- **The agent can:** create the corrected template with `create_template` (Full access)
- **Full steps:** https://docs.whatsable.app/features/message-templates.md, section "change-a-template-duplicate-it". For the person: https://docs.whatsable.app/features/message-templates#change-a-template-duplicate-it

## Preview a template

- **What it is:** The editor shows the message as the customer will see it.
- **Plan:** Bulk Message, Work, Growth, Pro, Agency, the 14-day trial and the Free plan.
- **Who can do it:** Owners, admins and members.
- **Where:** Templates > New template
- **The agent can:** read a template's text and variables with `get_template`
- **Full steps:** https://docs.whatsable.app/features/message-templates.md, section "create-a-template". For the person: https://docs.whatsable.app/features/message-templates#create-a-template

## One-time passcode (authentication) templates

- **What it is:** One-time passcode templates, whose text Meta writes.
- **Plan:** Bulk Message, Work, Growth, Pro, Agency, the 14-day trial and the Free plan.
- **Who can do it:** Owners, admins and members.
- **Where:** Templates > New template > Authentication
- **The agent can:** create one with `create_template`, category `authentication` (Full access)
- **Full steps:** https://docs.whatsable.app/features/message-templates.md, section "authentication-templates". For the person: https://docs.whatsable.app/features/message-templates#authentication-templates
